Teste.NotaIgnorado: Faded die: rolled, but left out of the sum.
Teste.NotaFalhaCritica: There is an extra penalty: the GM picks one or rolls for it (1d8).
Teste.NotaDesastre: Every die was wiped out by dread: disaster (critical failure).

Pre.SemHabilidades: No ability applies to this test.
Pre.AbracarEfeito: {custo} DP · the die becomes a bonus die

Erro.pd: Not enough DP for these choices.
Erro.impeto: Not enough drive for these choices.

Pre.DicaEspacos: Extra dice take these 2 slots (limit of 4 dice per test).

Ficha.DicaRolagem: Click a skill name to open the test window (Shift+click rolls right away).
Ficha.DicaPavor: They only apply to the next skill or aptitude test.
Ficha.DicaRelacoes: The dots are the bond's degree (click to change). Benefits are applied by hand; invoking marks the bond as used this mission and tells the table (at degrees 2 and 3, the chat card has a motivate button).
Ficha.RelacaoDescricao: How you feel about them (narrative only)
Ficha.DicaEfeitos: Injuries, traumas and temporary effects (a preparation, a blessing...) are listed together here, each with its description. On temporary effects, if you pick an attribute and steps, that attribute's die changes on tests; remove them by hand when they end.
Ficha.DicaItens: Items can be used without wielding them, which saves the time of equipping and stowing. You only need to wield an item to hold it, and it takes up your hands.
Ficha.DicaHabilidades: Profile abilities come first. Abilities with an automation show their controls here; the others are just a description.

Bonus.Dica: Up to 2 extra dice, for this test only.

Oposto.PorCritico: Decided by a critical success or failure.

Ajuda.SemDado: {nome} cannot help with {pericia}: at least d6 is required.

Lesao.NotaNaoLetal: Non-lethal damage: +1d6 on the test and 2d20 (the best) on the injury table.

Efeito.removeCondicoes: Is no longer unconscious and dying.

morteSubita.Descricao: The blow is instantly fatal. The character dies.

morteLenta.Descricao: The wound is mortal, but adrenaline allows one last action. Recovers 1 HP and, if unconscious, wakes up. Acts in the next round and dies at the end of it; nothing can prevent this.

lacearacaoProfunda.Descricao: A grave, permanent cut. Maximum HP is reduced by 2 forever. It can happen several times, and the effects stack.

semOlho.Descricao: Loses the use of an eye: −1 to Perception and Marksmanship.

semMao.Descricao: Loses the use of a hand or an arm. Can only wield one item; on two-handed tasks, takes a step reduction or fails automatically, at the GM's discretion.

semPe.Descricao: Loses the use of a foot or a leg. Takes two step reductions when advancing in foot chases and on movement actions.

tendaoComprometido.Descricao: A tendon loses capacity, reducing agility and flexibility: −2 to Acrobatics.

musculoComprometido.Descricao: A muscle loses capacity, reducing strength and speed: −2 to Athletics.

orgaoInternoComprometido.Descricao: An internal organ (heart, lung, liver...) loses capacity: −2 to Vigor.

orgaoSensorialComprometido.Descricao: A sense organ (eye, ear, nose...) loses capacity: −2 to Perception.

cicatrizAssustadora.Descricao: A mark that keeps people away: −2 to Persuasion and +1 to Intimidation.

contusao.Descricao: A blow too hard to shrug off: Physical drops one step until the end of the scene.

surtoAdrenalina.Descricao: The wound leaves no lasting effects and adrenaline restores 1 HP.

Pavor.PDInsuficiente: Not enough DP to control or embrace dread.

colapsoTotal.Descricao: The mind cannot bear the horror. The body stays alive, but empty.

estressePosTraumatico.Descricao: Every time the character takes emotional damage, the damage increases by 1. Lasts until cured.

degradacaoCognitiva.Descricao: Fear eats away at reasoning: −1 to tests that use Mind. Lasts until cured.

maculaPsiquica.Descricao: The world looks greyer: −1 to tests that use Emotion. Lasts until cured.

chagaAlma.Descricao: Something breaks in the spirit. Maximum DP is reduced by 2 until cured. It can happen several times, and the effects stack.

retracaoDefensiva.Descricao: The character shuts down and avoids social contact: −2 to Persuasion and Intuition. Lasts until cured.

panico.Descricao: Gains a dread die (d6). If the character already has dread, the die goes up one step.

estupor.Descricao: The character freezes and loses their action in the next round.

injecaoAnimo.Descricao: The trauma leaves no lasting effects and a surge of spirit restores 1 DP.

Aviso.semGrau: A neutral relationship (no dots) cannot be invoked.
Aviso.jaUsada: This relationship has already been used this mission.
Aviso.SoDono: Only whoever controls the character who invoked the bond can motivate.

Chat.Teste: +1d{dado} on a test directly tied to {pessoa}.
Chat.Ajuda: When helping {pessoa}: +1d{dado} on their test, on top of the help's step increase.
Chat.Motivar: Spending an action to motivate {pessoa}: they recover {dados}d{faces} DP.
Chat.AcaoExtra: If {pessoa} is in danger: an extra action to help them (tell the GM; the table decides how it plays out).
Chat.Manual: Whoever receives the bonus writes it down by hand on the test. The GM may also grant bonuses outside the rules.

Recuperacao.SemAlvo: Select your character's token (or have a character assigned) to recover.

Item.DicaUso: With a use limit, each use spends one remaining use; with no limit, only consumables are spent from the quantity.
Item.ConfirmarRemover: Remove this item from the sheet?
Item.DicaMao: Many items can be used without being in hand. Tick "In hand" only to hold the item: it takes one or two hands, and you have two in total.
Item.DicaAutomacao: The automation ties the ability to a system behavior. With no automation, it is just a description.

Automacoes.impeto: Drive bar (failures fill it; spend it for bonuses)
Automacoes.impetoInicial: Starting drive (1 space every new scene)
Automacoes.analise: Analysis markers (adjust the dice after the test)
Automacoes.prontidao: Reroll a die (2 DP, once per test)
Automacoes.esquiva: Free dodge (Acrobatics opposed to the attack)
Automacoes.sorrateiro: Extra die on Crime or Stealth (3 DP)

Armadura.Pergunta: Spend 1 armor point to reduce a {dano} damage hit by {reducao}? ({restantes} left)
Armadura.Usada: Armor point spent: {bruto} damage reduced by {reducao}.

Equipamento.SemAlvo: Target at least one token to apply the damage.
Equipamento.SoMestre: Only whoever controls {nome} can apply damage to them: ask the GM.
Equipamento.SemUso: {nome} has no uses left and is not consumable.

Bloqueio.maos: No free hands: unequip a weapon or an item first.
Bloqueio.armadura: Only one armor can be worn at a time: take the other off first.

Habilidade.ImpetoPassoEscolha: Attribute that goes up one step until the end of the scene:
Habilidade.EfeitoImpetoDescricao: The attribute die goes up one step until the end of the scene.
Habilidade.ImpetoPassoTexto: spends 3 drive spaces: {atributo} goes up one step until the end of the scene.
Habilidade.ImpetoAcaoTexto: spends 3 drive spaces to take an extra action.
Habilidade.ImpetoAcaoDetalhe: Tell the GM: how the extra action plays out is up to the table.
Habilidade.AnaliseGanha: spends an action and gains {valor} analysis marker(s).
Habilidade.CuraSemAlvo: Target the token of the ally to be healed.
Habilidade.CuraEmSi: The healing is for an ally, not for yourself.
Habilidade.CuraJaCurou: {nome} has already received this healing this scene.
Habilidade.NovaCenaConfirmar: Reset this character's scene? It clears the scene's injury and trauma tests, empties drive and analysis, removes until-end-of-scene effects and restores 1 HP if at 0.
Habilidade.AnaliseDica: Each marker changes a die by 1 point (minimum 1, up to the die's maximum). Markers available: {pontos}. Type the new value of each die.
Habilidade.AnaliseInvalida: Invalid values or not enough markers.
Habilidade.AnaliseNota: {nome} uses {pontos} analysis marker(s) to adjust the dice.
Habilidade.ProntidaoJaUsada: This ability has already been used on this test.
Habilidade.ProntidaoSemPD: Not enough DP to reroll the die.
Habilidade.ProntidaoNota: {nome} spends DP to roll the d{dado} again: {de} → {para}.
Habilidade.AnimalFerido: The companion got hurt and no longer helps this scene.
Habilidade.Sorrateiro: +d8 on the next Crime or Stealth test (3 DP)
